name: Henrique Braun

education.institution: Federal Rural University of Rio de Janeiro

career.title: Trainee in global engineering (Atlanta), then roles in supply chain, bottling, new business development, marketing and innovation
Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer

background_rationale: A 30-year Coca-Cola insider who started as an engineering trainee and rose through supply chain, bottling and general management of regional operating units to become COO overseeing all operating units.

notable.summary: On being named CEO-designate, Braun said he would focus on continuing the momentum built with Coca-Cola's bottling system and saw large opportunities in a fast-changing global market.

In his first quarterly results as CEO, Coca-Cola reported 12% net revenue growth to $12.5 billion, with Braun citing a focus on staying close to the consumer, executing locally and managing complexity.
Coca-Cola rolled out a single unified visual identity system for the Coca-Cola brand across more than 200 markets.
Coca-Cola reported second-quarter net revenue up 7% to $13.4 billion, with Braun saying the company delivered by staying close to consumers' and customers' changing needs.

personal_story.hook: Born in California and raised in Brazil, Henrique Braun joined Coca-Cola as an engineering trainee in 1996 and now runs it.
personal_story.summary: Braun was born in California and raised in Brazil, and holds U.S. and Brazilian citizenship. He studied agricultural engineering at the Federal Rural University of Rio de Janeiro, then earned a master's at Michigan State and an MBA at Georgia State. He joined Coca-Cola in Atlanta in 1996 as a trainee in global engineering and worked across supply chain, bottling, marketing and innovation on four continents. Running Greater China and South Korea, then Brazil and Latin America, set him up for the COO job in 2025 and the CEO role on March 31, 2026.
